# National Today

> A comprehensive daily holiday and observance guide celebrating national, cultural, and special interest holidays throughout the year.

National Today provides curated holiday calendars, celebrity birthdays, and observances organized by category and date. The site serves as a reference for discovering daily celebrations, awareness months, and cultural events both in the United States and internationally.

## Key Topics

- holiday-calendar
- daily-holidays
- birthday-calendar
- celebrity-birthdays

- Navratri
- St. Joseph's Day

## Core Navigation

- [National Today](https://nationaltoday.com): Homepage celebrating daily holidays and observances with deals and contests.
- [What is Today?](https://nationaltoday.com/today): Daily holiday listings for current date with celebrations and observances.
- [National Day Topics](https://nationaltoday.com/national-day-topics): Directory organizing national holidays by category and topic.

## Holiday Categories

- [Federal Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/federal-holidays): Reference guide to U.S. federal holidays and national celebrations.
- [Cultural Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/cultural-holidays): International cultural holidays celebrating heritage, traditions, and customs.
- [Religious Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/religious-holidays): Multi-faith religious holidays celebrating spirituality and togetherness.
- [Animal Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/animal-holidays): Comprehensive calendar of animal-related holidays throughout the year.
- [Food and Beverage Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/food-beverage-holidays): Directory of food and beverage holidays for foodies throughout year.
- [Arts & Entertainment Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/arts-entertainment-holidays): Archive of arts and entertainment holidays from pop culture to fine art.
- [Health Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/health-holidays): Health awareness holidays covering medical conditions and wellness.
- [Cause Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/cause-holidays): Organization-supported cause holidays promoting positive social impact.

## Relationship & Special Interest Holidays

- [Relationship Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/relationship-holidays): Holidays celebrating relationships, family, friends, and love.
- [Special Interest Holidays](https://nationaltoday.com/special-interest-holidays): Niche holidays covering hobbies, activities, and special interests.

## Birthday Calendar

- [Birthday Archives](https://nationaltoday.com/birthday): Archive of notable celebrity and historical figure birthdays.
- [January Birthdays](https://nationaltoday.com/january-birthdays): Notable January birthdays including celebrities and historical figures.
- [February Birthdays](https://nationaltoday.com/february-birthdays): Notable February birthdays including celebrities and historical figures.
- [March Birthdays](https://nationaltoday.com/march-birthdays): Notable March birthdays including celebrities and historical figures.
- [April Birthdays](https://nationaltoday.com/april-birthdays): Notable April birthdays including celebrities and historical figures.
- [May Birthdays](https://nationaltoday.com/may-birthdays): Notable May birthdays including celebrities and historical figures.
- [June Birthdays](https://nationaltoday.com/june-birthdays): Notable June birthdays including celebrities and historical figures.
